text: Recuperate locally in safety. It is free and takes 4 turns. On completion, severe permanent injuries are replaced with Scarred. Recalling the officer early cancels treatment, with no additional recall delay.

Send the officer on an assignment abroad to seek treatment from a foreign renowned physician. It costs 4,000 and takes 1 turn away from military duties. On completion, severe permanent injuries are replaced with Scarred. Recalling the officer early cancels treatment; the payment is not refunded and there is no additional recall delay.

While the army replenishes in a settlement, the renowned physician Hua Tuo happens to pass through. He offers to treat one officer suffering a permanent severe injury. For 2,000 gold, the injury will be replaced with Scarred.
